**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

**Prep Time:** 15 minutes | **Cook Time:** 18 minutes | **Servings:** 8

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Yield: 8 scones

Prep time: 20 minutes

Cook time: 15 minutes

Total time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter and use a pastry cutter or fingers to incorporate until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with vanilla glaze.

Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

Here's the **Blueberry Scones** recipe from Coded Culinary:

---

### **Ingredients**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  
- 1 large egg  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  

---

### **Instructions**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  
3. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. Gently fold in blueberries.  
5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.  
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.  
7. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 15–18 minutes until golden brown.  
8. Cool on a wire rack before serving.  

---

### **Details**
- **Prep Time:** 15 minutes  
- **Cook Time:** 18 minutes  
- **Servings:** 8  

Enjoy your flaky, blueberry-filled scones! 🥐

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

# Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing  
- 1 large egg  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  

## Instructions
1. **Preheat** oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. In a large bowl, **whisk together** flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  
3. **Cut in** cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. In a separate bowl, **whisk together** cream, egg, and vanilla.  
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently **fold in blueberries**.  
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and **pat into a 1-inch thick circle**. Cut into 8 wedges.  
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, **brush tops with cream**.  
8. **Bake for 15–18 minutes** until golden brown.  

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.  
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.
